facts.business: Frontier Springs Limited manufactures and supplies goods, primarily to the railway sector, recognizing revenue upon transfer of control of goods to the customer.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Revenue recognition due to retention norms of 2% or 5% in railway purchase orders and timing of revenue recognition around year-end. Total retention amount for period ended 31/03/2026 amounts to ₹ 26,70,323 out of total trade receivables, of which ₹ 18,73,080 recovered up to 12/05/2026.

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to retention norms of 2% or 5% in railway purchase orders
Timing of revenue recognition around year-end due to shipment terms and railway tenders
Economic conditions affecting demand and supply
Prices of raw materials and energy
Changes in government policy, regulation and taxation
